resources.string: Chat with %1$s in other messaging apps.
Once connected, you can message %1$s from WeChat.
If you continue, your conversation with %1$s is linked to a chat of its own in WeChat. %1$s cannot read any of your other WeChat chats, and you can disconnect at any time.
Connecting means scanning a code with WeChat to bind a bot of your own. After a long silence in WeChat, WeChat may hold back messages %1$s starts; they go out once you send something there.
Messages from WeChat will no longer reach %1$s. The WeChat chat here and its history stay.
WeChat cannot be reached right now. Trying again.
Some messages could not go out yet, most likely after a long silence in WeChat. They go out once you send something there.
There are too many side chats. Delete a few to receive WeChat messages.
Something went wrong with WeChat. Trying again.
Scan the code with WeChat on your phone, then confirm in WeChat. With only this phone, save the code first, then pick it from your photos in WeChat\'s Scan.
Scanned. Confirm in WeChat on your phone.
WeChat on your phone shows a number. Enter it here.
That number did not match. Try again.
Try sending %1$s a message in WeChat.
The code expired too many times. Try again.
Too many wrong numbers. Try again later.
This WeChat is already bound. If messages do not arrive, remove the old bot in WeChat and connect again.
That took too long. Scan again.
There are too many side chats. Delete a few, then connect.
Could not reach WeChat. Check your connection and try again.
